The effective state after lease release must be non-ready (BLOCKED or a distinct fail-closed SHORTFALL state), the missing activation dependency must remain machine-readable, and a later explicit dependency-satisfied/coordinator transition must make it ready again. Existing append-only events and shortfall evidence must remain intact.
